- The "net outlays **by function**" phrasing actually points to the **monthly total net outlays** grand-total row in the by-function summary table (not a single function).
- "latest treasury bulletin table to include all of these monthly values in one place" is a recurring hint that one consolidated table has the full FY.
- Fiscal-year boundary (Oct–Sep for FY1977+) for selecting the 12 months.
- Population std dev = pstdev (÷N), the main arithmetic trap.

The population-vs-sample mechanic was already in the skill, but the table-identification and FY-month-selection logic for this question class was not. Memory already covers the broad format/delimiter rules and is near its char cap, so no memory update is warranted.

Done — skill patched.
